integrity: A finite exhaustive lower certificate and full reproducible upper covering census are provided. All 1641 labeled even words and 274 relabeling classes are checked from definitions; no independence of review is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The exact theorem concerns only ternary even words of length eight (half-length four).
No all-length conjecture, dihedral-covering claim, or uniqueness of optimal families follows.
Related later full texts were not all accessible; priority beyond inspected scientific material is not guaranteed.
title: Seven permutations suffice and are necessary for ternary length-four shuffle coverings
